commands: # Collect all instances and their security groups across regions # and determine which ones allow SSH from the internet REGIONS=("us-east-1" "us-west-1" "us-west-2") declare -A all_instances declare -A sg_details # Function to get security groups for an instance (direct + from launch template) get_instance_sgs() { local region=$1 local instance_id=$2 local sgs=() # Get directly attached security groups direct_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --instance-ids "$instance_id" --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].SecurityGroups[*].GroupId' --output json) while IFS= read -r sg; do sg=$(echo "$sg" | tr -d '"') if [ -n "$sg" ]; then sgs+=("$sg") fi done < <(echo "$direct_sgs" | jq -r '.[]') # Get security groups from launch template if present lt_id=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --instance-ids "$instance_id" --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].LaunchTemplate.LaunchTemplateId' --output text 2>/dev/null) if [ "$lt_id" != "None" ] && [ -n "$lt_id" ]; then template_sgs=$(aws ec2 describe-launch-template-versions --region "$region" --launch-template-id "$lt_id" --query 'LaunchTemplateVersions[0].LaunchTemplateData.SecurityGroupIds[]' --output json 2>/dev/null) while IFS= read -r sg; do sg=$(echo "$sg" | tr -d '"') if [ -n "$sg" ] && [[ ! " ${sgs[@]} " =~ " ${sg} " ]]; then sgs+=("$sg") fi done < <(echo "$template_sgs" | jq -r '.[]' 2>/dev/null) fi echo "${sgs[@]}" } # Function to check if a security group allows SSH from the internet allows_ssh_from_internet() { local region=$1 local sg_id=$2 # Check for rules allowing port 22 from 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0 ssh_rules=$(aws ec2 describe-security-groups --region "$region" --group-ids "$sg_id" --query 'SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions[?FromPort<=`22` && ToPort>=`22`]' --output json) echo "$ssh_rules" | jq -r '.[] | select((.IpRanges[]?.CidrIp == "0.0.0.0/0") or (.Ipv6Ranges[]?.CidrIpv6 == "::/0")) | "true"' | grep -q "true" } echo "Scanning for SSH-accessible instances..." echo "" # Collect all instances for region in "${REGIONS[@]}"; do echo "Querying $region..." aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --query 'Reservations[*].Instances[*].[InstanceId,State.Name,Tags[?Key==`Name`].Value|[0],LaunchTemplate.LaunchTemplateId]' --output json > /tmp/instances_$region.json done # Process instances and check for SSH accessibility echo "" echo "Checking security groups for internet-facing SSH..." echo "" ssh_accessible=() for region in "${REGIONS[@]}"; do instances=$(jq -r '.[][] | @json' /tmp/instances_$region.json) while IFS= read -r instance_json; do instance=$(echo "$instance_json" | jq -r '.[0]') state=$(echo "$instance_json" | jq -r '.[1]') name=$(echo "$instance_json" | jq -r '.[2] // "N/A"') if [ "$state" != "terminated" ]; then sgs=$(get_instance_sgs "$region" "$instance") # Check if any security group allows SSH from internet ssh_open=false for sg in $sgs; do if allows_ssh_from_internet "$region" "$sg"; then ssh_open=true break fi done if [ "$ssh_open" = true ]; then ssh_accessible+=("$instance|$region|$name|$state|$sgs") fi fi done < <(echo "$instances") done # Output results echo "SSH-Accessible Instances from the Internet:" echo "===========================================" echo "" if [ ${#ssh_accessible[@]} -eq 0 ]; then echo "No instances found that allow SSH access from the internet (0.0.0.0/0)." else echo "Instance ID | Region | Name | State | Security Groups" echo "------|--------|------|-------|------------------" for item in "${ssh_accessible[@]}"; do IFS='|' read -r instance_id region name state sgs <<< "$item" echo "$instance_id | $region | $name | $state | $sgs" done fi

# Get detailed information about the SSH-accessible instance instance_id="i-c78c5d862cbbd5c3e" region="us-east-1" sg_id="sg-2aa9650a4a37f8428" echo "Instance Details:" echo "=================" aws ec2 describe-instances --region "$region" --instance-ids "$instance_id" --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].[InstanceId,InstanceType,State.Name,Tags[?Key==`Name`].Value|[0],PrivateIpAddress,PublicIpAddress,LaunchTemplate]' --output json | jq '.' echo "" echo "Security Group Configuration:" echo "=============================" aws ec2 describe-security-groups --region "$region" --group-ids "$sg_id" --output json | jq '.SecurityGroups[0] | {GroupId, GroupName, VpcId, IpPermissions}' echo "" echo "SSH Rule Details (0.0.0.0/0):" echo "=============================" aws ec2 describe-security-groups --region "$region" --group-ids "$sg_id" --query 'SecurityGroups[0].IpPermissions[?FromPort<=`22` && ToPort>=`22`]' --output json | jq '.'
